meta.title: Hoorpendar | Industrial Electronics, Control & Instrumentation
meta.description: Since 1999, Hoorpendar has designed and manufactured industrial electronic equipment and delivered control, automation and instrumentation projects for oil and gas, water and power, and other industries.

home.title: We design and build our own industrial control and instrumentation equipment
home.lead: Since 1999 we have worked for power plants, dams, oil and gas and other industries. Each project starts with study and design. We build the hardware ourselves, install and commission it, and keep supporting it afterwards.
home.productsTitle: Products with years of service in the field
home.productsLead: A few of the units we have installed at power plants, refineries and oil and gas stations.
home.plantsEyebrow: Power plants, dams and offshore platforms
home.plantsLead: Hoorpendar excitation systems, dam level meters, flame detection and alarm systems are installed at hydro and thermal power plants and dams across Iran.

projects.title: Projects
projects.lead: Since 2001 we have carried out 138 contracts in oil and gas, water and power, and other industries. Some covered a single piece of equipment; others were complete EPC (engineering, procurement and construction) projects.

products.title: Equipment we design and build ourselves
products.lead: We supply support and spare parts for every product here ourselves. Most can be built to the voltage, size and specification a project needs.
products.customNote: Need a different voltage, size or interface? We will design and build the unit to your specification. To request a quote, send your request through the Atirame chat.
products.renewalStepsTitle: How we renew a legacy system
products.renewalCta: Tell Atirame the part number or model of the unit in the chat, and our engineers will assess it.
